text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before training, I handed Duramente the 
fan letters that had arrived for her.
choice_data_list: Yes, it's a fan letter for you.
Yes, it's a fan letter for you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ! A fan letter... for me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente took her time slowly reading the 
letter. Her eyes swept back and forth 
across the page over and over again.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...No. Let's begin our training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...Haa... haa... Pheeew-...."
choice_data_list: Let's wrap it up for today.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"No—I want to push a bit more. My body is 
fine."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, in addition to her regular 
routine, she's already done matched 
running and hill sprints today. Pushing 
her any further would surely be too 
much...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Even a light routine is fine. ...Please.
choice_data_list: Aren't you unusually fired up today?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ………… ...In a letter.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It was written in that letter. "I saw hope 
in your powerful running." "Please 
continue to do your best forever"... it 
said.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I can't put it into words very well, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I felt that your expectations of me... 
were different from those of my clan."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
‘I want to live up to it’—that was what I 
felt.
choice_data_list:
You didn't just take on their 
expectations, but their wishes too, huh.

You didn't just take on their 
expectations, but their wishes too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fans support her not because she's 
from a prestigious family, but as an 
individual Umamusume. Duramente likely 
felt that, too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...A wish. I see...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Is that why right now, so fiercely... the 
fire within me is burning...?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. Once more, I ask of you. Just a 
little more training."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"To everyone who wrote me letters... I 
want to show them me at my strongest, 
running the ultimate race!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I... want to become stronger and stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shouldering a new "wish" upon her back, 
Duramente surged forward.
